items.question: Which bodily marks, cosmetics, and ornaments belong to the contemplated female form in this yoga practice?
premises: The verse lists bodily marks and ornaments.
The listed items are connected by ca.
The context concerns contemplating a female form.
items.inference: These items are to be included among the contemplated features of the female form.
uncertainties: The exact grammatical case and ritual function of each listed item are not specified by the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Breasts, collyrium, parting, bracelets, ornaments, and so on.
